label: Research
title: Find the question.
detail: I start with what the audience is asking, then check the subject. The research travels with the script: the claim, its source, the graphic and who checks it. That gives the team something concrete to work from.

label: Creative strategy
title: Choose the angle.
detail: For TruNativ, premium positioning had to sit alongside clear information and everyday use. I work out the promise, the questions a film needs to answer and the format that can carry it. The identity and the explanation have to work together.

label: Ideas & writing
title: Write it. Board it.
lines: Work out the film before the shoot.
detail: I turn the angle into a script, then work out the action and coverage. These Zoho planning boards connect the office movement, product passage and calmer explanation. A production-heavy idea needs a board; a conversation needs room to happen.

label: Production & team briefs
title: Brief the room.
detail: I set the direction, timelines and handoffs so the team knows what the edit will need. The camera plan protects the conversation and reactions; the sound plan protects usable dialogue. Briefs connect the creative idea to practical coverage and delivery.

label: Editing & retention
title: Shape the edit.
lines: The opening. The pacing. The payoff.
Keep the promise of the title.
detail: I edit and lead the edit. The title and cover set a promise; the opening has to deliver it. An interview, a food programme and an archive marathon need different structures. I brief and review against that structure, then carry the cut through finishing.

label: Identity & motion graphics
title: Build the system.
detail: I build visual language around what the show is explaining. The Product Report uses a glass identity, cool purple and green accents and steady surfaces for evidence. Titles, source panels and comparisons become a reusable system for the next episode.

label: AI & VFX direction
title: Make the hard shot.
detail: I set the references and shot priorities before generation. Face, hair, physique, wardrobe and adjacent shots need a shared continuity check. I take the selected shot through cleanup, compositing and review so it fits the film, rather than sitting outside it.

label: Testing & performance
title: Test. Review. Repeat.
lines: Use the result to brief the next version.
detail: I agree the question and the decision rule before a test starts. Change an opening, explanation or performer while keeping the proposition comparable. I review attention alongside acquisition and conversion, then use the result to commission the next brief.
